pending_commit.commit_message: firmware_Cr50CCDServoCap: change acceptable I2C states The I2C gpio is open drain. We don't have a lot of control on whether it has the necessary pull up to make Cr50 think it is deasserted. Accept the state that Cr50 thinks I2C is enabled even though it probably isn't. If Cr50 correctly detects servo and disables the uart TX signals and the SPI signal it's probably also disabling I2C. CHROMIUM: drm/img-rogue: Enable GPU clock frequency transition debug log Add additional debug logs related to 'GPU clock frequencies transition' and extra information from MTKSysDevPostPowerState. For the debug log 'GPU clock frequencies transition', the "calibrated" clock speed we mean a frequency calculated by the driver by sampling the CPU and GPU timers together at two different points in time, and then figuring out what the GPU clock speed was between those two points. ui32PowerEventCalibratedClockSpeed is calculated using as points in time certain GPU power events (DVFS, power on/off), and it is also calculated periodically. ui32ForcedIdleCalibratedClockSpeed is calculated around the time when the driver waits for a forced idle request to complete. It is calculated only if a request times out. The system layer clock speed mentioned in the error message is the clock speed provided by the host. Note that this change is temporary and only used as an experiment; will be reverted once we catch the related information for issue b:35648545. BUG=b:35648545 TEST=boot to UI and run graphics_GLBench Change-Id: I69553298ae42fa748c80894cec1438ae6eeaaf99 Signed-off-by: Afar Lin <afar.lin@imgtec.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/813557 Commit-Ready: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Tested-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Daniel Kurtz <djkurtz@chromium.org>

stage: Add argument to move files locally instead of copying. In some use cases of staging files from a local path, we begin by preparing the files to stage in a tempdir, we then stage these files via the RPC and immediately delete the source file. This CL adds an argument to the stage RPC to be used when staging local files that directs us to simply move the files instead of copying. This is especially useful when the devserver is running in a VM (moblab VM) where the staging time goes down from ~30 minutes to 3 minutes after this change. BUG=chromium:799724 TEST=Run 'cros stage' on a moblab vm. chromeos-config: Form the ebuild name from the overlay name At present we use the 'base model' to form the chromeos-firmware-xxx name where xxx is the base model. This name is part of the URI whence the firmware is collected. The 'base model' is the model that actually provides the firmware, taking account of firmware sharing. In practice we don't always store the firmware in this place, however. A better way to determine the correct name is to extract it from the 'overlay-xxx-private' overlay name. This works for coral and reef. It should also work for reef migration, but that remains to be seen.
